## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition Filters (Standard)

```sql
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
```

### Timezone Filter (Revenue Computation)

```sql
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Rolling Window (Multi-Day Span)

```sql
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE('${grass_date}'), 364)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Cost Filter (Only Non-Zero Deduction)

```sql
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE('${grass_date}'), 364)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d + paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d
    + free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d + free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d > 0
```

## Common Aggregations

### Simple SUM per Shop/Region

```sql
SELECT shop_id
      ,grass_region
      ,SUM(paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_local_1d) AS paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_local
      ,SUM(paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_local_1d) AS paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_local
      ,SUM(free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_local_1d) AS free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_local
      ,SUM(free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_local_1d) AS free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_local
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertiser_deduction_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
GROUP BY shop_id, grass_region
```

### Compute ads_rev_usd (All USD Fields Sum)

```sql
SELECT shop_id
      ,grass_date
      ,paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d
        + paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d
        + free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d
        + free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d AS ads_rev_usd
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertiser_deduction_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE('${grass_date}'), 364)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d
    + paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d
    + free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d
    + free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d > 0
```

### Time-Windowed Rolling SUM (30/60/365 Day)

```sql
SELECT shop_id
      ,SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 29 DAYS)
                 AND DATE('${grass_date}')
           THEN ads_rev_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ads_rev_usd_30d
      ,SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 59 DAYS)
                 AND (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 30 DAYS)
           THEN ads_rev_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ads_rev_usd_30_60d
      ,SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 364 DAYS)
                 AND (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 60 DAYS)
           THEN ads_rev_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ads_rev_usd_60_365d
FROM (
    SELECT shop_id, grass_date
          ,paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d + paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d
           + free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d + free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d AS ads_rev_usd
    FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertiser_deduction_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND grass_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE('${grass_date}'), 364)
      AND tz_type = 'local'
      AND paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d + paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d
        + free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d + free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d > 0
) a
GROUP BY shop_id
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

### Production Pipeline

```
[dwd_advertiser_transaction_di__reg_s0_live]                    [dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live]
    |                                                                 |
    | explode paid_free_expiry_summary.entries                         |
    | WHERE event_code in (1,11,15)                                    |
    |                                                                 |
    v                                                                 v
[base_data_local / base_data_reg temp views] --- LEFT JOIN ------------+
    |
    | CASE WHEN entry_type=1→paid_wo_expiry, =2→paid_w_expiry,
    |         =3→free_wo_expiry, =4→free_w_expiry
    | amount / 100000 → local amount, / exchange_rate → USD
    | SUM() GROUP BY shop_id, grass_region
    |
    v
[dws_advertiser_deduction_1d__reg_s0_live]
    |
    | INSERT OVERWRITE PARTITION (tz_type='local', grass_region, grass_date)
    | INSERT OVERWRITE PARTITION (tz_type='regional', grass_region, grass_date)
    |
    +--> tz_type='local': based on event_timestamp >= grass_date AND < grass_date+1
    +--> tz_type='regional': based on grass_date filter (BETWEEN grass_date-1 AND grass_date)
```

### Partition Strategy

- **Dynamic partition insert**: `INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ... PARTITION (tz_type = 'local'/'regional', grass_region, grass_date)`
- Each task writes both `local` and `regional` tz_type partitions for one region

| 3 | Free credit, no expiry | free_expenditure_wo_expiry |
| 4 | Free credit, with expiry | free_expenditure_w_expiry |

```sql
ads_rev_usd = paid_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d
            + paid_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d
            + free_expenditure_wo_expiry_amt_usd_1d
            + free_expenditure_w_expiry_amt_usd_1d
```
